story.text: Welcome to the [[Plugin Lab]] — a local FedWiki farm host for prototyping wiki plugins. Owned by Mitch.
This site stages experiments before they ship. Build a plugin, drop an instance on a page here, and watch it render live.

# The shelf

- [[The Native Plugins]] — every plugin the federation runs: the commons set (Ward Cunningham, Eric Dobbs, the core), and the two forged here.
- [[Tile Glyph Plugin]] — colored, animated page tiles with an emoji/ASCII glyph for category navigation.
- [[Root Tiles]] — the federation-wide tile registry. · [[Tile Wall]] · [[Tile Index]]

# Skills this lab builds around
- [[FedWiki Cohere Sync]]
- [[FedWiki Transcribe]]
- [[Spellbook Ornaments]]
